h1: Custom Pocketed Shirts for Bulk Orders
metaDescription: Order custom pocketed shirts for your team. Perfect for uniforms, with chest or patch pockets. Get a quote at Perfect Imprints.
introHtml: Pocketed shirts add functionality to your uniform program, giving employees a convenient place to store pens, badges, or small tools. From oxfords with chest pockets to overshirts with patch pockets, these styles keep your team looking professional while staying practical. Decorate with embroidery or screen printing for a polished finish.
heroAltText: Custom pocketed shirts with chest pocket, ideal for corporate uniforms and promotional giveaways
